name: Brian Boulder
caption: A fan-favorite grappler who opened the MCMW's first televised Monday Night Mayhem with a win, and who spends much of the promotion's early run entangled in a brother-turned-rival storyline with Hans Helmet.

name: Evan Rice

name: King of the Beasts
caption: Half of Khan's tag team the Lords of the Jungle, billed at over four hundred pounds and credited with the pinfall in the team's win on the MCMW's first televised Monday Night Mayhem.

caption: A rulebreaker who won by countout on the MCMW's first televised Monday Night Mayhem, then brawled with Hans Helmet and Brian Boulder in the post-match angle that opened their feud.

name: The Rebel
caption: A scientific wrestler who battled The Great Kamikaze to a restarted, hard-fought finish in the main event of the MCMW's first televised Monday Night Mayhem, continuing an old independent-scene feud.

name: The Great Kamikaze
caption: A high-flying rulebreaker who main-evented the MCMW's first televised Monday Night Mayhem against The Rebel in a match the federation's own broadcast calls an instant classic.

caption: The MCMW's first-ever champion, billed since he won a twenty-man battle royal at MatWar on 18 July 1995 and defended the title through the federation's last surviving records.
